title: BQA: Body Language Question Answering Dataset for Video Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing and comparing the error rates (incorrect prediction percentages) of VideoLLMs on emotion recognition tasks across different age groups (Kids, Teens, Adults) featured in the videos.
Analyzing and comparing the error rates of VideoLLM predictions across different ethnic groups (e.g., Asian, Black, Hispanic, Native American, Native Hawaiian, White) annotated in the dataset.
Evaluating and comparing the tendency of VideoLLMs to make incorrect emotion predictions based on whether the video features a male or female subject.
